senses.gloss:
(इ) मकि r. 1st cl. (मङ्कते)
1 To decorate, to grace or adorn.
2 To go, to move.

r. 1st cl. (-मक्कते)
To go, to move.

m. (-रः)
1 A marine monster, confounded usually with the crocodile and shark, but properly a fabulous animal: as a fish; it might be conjectured to be the horned shark, or the unicorn fish; but it is often drawn, as in the pictured signs of the zodiac, with the head and forelegs of an antelope, and the body and tail of a fish: it is the emblem of the god of love.
2 One of the signs of zodiac, corresponding with CAPRICORN, and like the Greek representation of that sign, being an animal in the foreparts, and ending in the tail of a fish.
3 One of KUVERA'S treasures.
E.
म for मुख the mouth, कृ to scatter, aff. अच्; or माङ् prohibitive aff., कृ to do, अच् aff., form irr.; grammarians however, sometimes consider this word as a primitive.

m. (-नः)
KĀMA, the Hindu CUPID.
E.
मकर a marine monster, and केतन emblem; being painted on KĀMA'S banner.

m. (-तुः)
KĀMA: see the preceding.
E.
मकर, and केतु an emblem.

m. (-जः)
KĀMA: see the two last.
E.
मकर the Makara, and ध्वज emblem.

m. (-न्दः)
1 The nectar or honey of a flower.
2 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
3 A bee.
4 A fragrant kind of mango.
5 A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum pubescens.)
6 The filament of a lotus.
E.
मकर the emblem of KĀMA, and दो to destroy, i. e. to surpass, as an incentive to love, aff. क, form irr.

f. (-ती)
The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
E.
मकरन्द honey, and मतुप् aff., fem. form.

m. (-रः)
The ocean.
E.
मकर a marine monster, and आकर receptacle.

m. (-रः)
A plant, said to be a species of Karanja or Cæsalpinia.
E.
मकर a fish, आकार form.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 KĀMADEVA.
2 The ocean.
E.
मकर a marine monster, and अङ्क mark, emblem.

m. (-यः)
The ocean.
E.
मकर a sort of fish, and आलय abode.

m. (-श्वः)
VARUṆA.
E.
मकर a marine monster, and अश्व a horse; riding on the Makara.

m. (-री)
The ocean.
E.
मकर a marine monster, and इनि aff.

n. (-टं)
A crest, a head-dress, a crown, a tiara.
E.
मकि to adorn, aff. उट, form irr.

f. (-तिः)
An edict or order of the government, addressed to the Śūdra tribe, or to a Śūdra.

m. (-रः)
1 A mirror.
2 The stick of a potter's wheel.
3 An unblown flower.
4 A tree with light yellow, and fragrant flowers, (Mimusops elengi.)
E.
मकि to adorn, उरच् Uṇādi aff., and deriv. irr.; also मुकुर.

m. (-लः)
1 An opening bud.
2 A kind of tree, (Mimusops elengi.)
E.
मकि to adorn, उलच् aff., deriv. irr.

m. (-कः)
A kind of kidney-bean, a wild variety perhaps of the Phaseolus mungo.
E.
मकु irr. deriv., from मक to adorn, ष्टक to impede, aff. अच्; also मकुष्ठक.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Going lazily, slowly, &c.
m. (-ष्ठः)
A sort of rice.
E.
मकि to adorn, aff. उ, deriv. irr. मकु, and स्था to stand, aff. क; also मुकुष्ठ.

m. (-कः)
A sort of kidney-bean.
E.
मकु ornament: (see the two last); स्था to stay or be, aff. क्वुन्.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Danti.
E.
मक to adorn, ऊलच् aff., and कन् added.

n. (-लं)
A mineral substance, considered variously to be chalk or benzoin.
E.
मक्क to go, to be, aff. ऊलच.

m. (-लः)
Chalk: see the last.
E.
मल्ल to go, ओलच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (मक्षति)
1 To fill.
2 To be angry.
3 To mix, to combine.

m. (-क्षः)
Hypocrisy, slyness, concealment of one's own defects.
E.
मक्ष to fill, aff. अच्.

(इ) माक्षि r. 1st cl. (मांक्षति)
To desire.

f. (-का)
A fly.
E.
मक्ष to be angry, Uṇādi aff. सिकन्, or मक्ष the same, क्वुन् aff.

f. (-का)
A fly.
E.
see the last, the pen. vowel made long.

n. (-कं)
1 A mineral substance, of which two kinds are described; the स्वर्णमाक्षिक or gold Mākṣika, of a bright yellow colour, apparently the common pyritic iron ore: and the रूप्यमाक्षिक or silver Mākṣika, which answers in appearance to the Hepatic pyrites of iron; other names of these ores occur; as, विट्माक्षिक and कांस्यमाक्षिक, or feculent Mākṣika and mixed metal Mākṣika; they are however, perhaps rather synonyms of the gold and silver ore, respectively, than names of distinct species.
2 Honey.
E.
माक्षिका a bee, अण् aff. of derivation; the name is applied to the ore, from its honey-like colour.

m. (-न्दः)
The mango.
f. (-न्दी)
1 Emblic myrobalan.
2 Yellow saunders.
3 The name of a city.
E.
मा beauty, and कन्द root.

m. (-लिः)
1 The charioteer of INDRA.
2 The moon.

n. (-जं)
Bee's wax.
E.
माक्षिक honey, and ज born.

f. (-रा)
A kind of sugar, candied sugar.

n. (-यं)
1 Bee's wax.
2 A honey-comb.
E.
माक्षिक honey, आश्रय receptacle.
